observations.claim: Rio Tinto moved Lithium into the Aluminium product group, explicitly stating that the combined structure enables shared deployment of productivity initiatives such as the Safe Production System, which it says had been a key driver of improved Aluminium performance.
Rio Tinto also unified its iron-ore operations and stated that the portfolio would share safety best practices, cutting-edge technologies and operational experience across the Iron Ore portfolio.

limitations: This establishes an explicit organizational mechanism for transferring operating practices and technology across businesses; it does not quantify realized financial benefit from cross-division transfer and does not support a numeric Methodology score.
